final_rationale: The verdict does not improve because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence; the response mainly reframed the same record more narrowly and more accurately. That narrowed framing is relevant, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats on this record because the required caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate: policy requires disclosure of material limitations and evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts, and there is still no evidence that the final certification/model-card artifact contains that disclosure or that approved risk acceptance exists. The admissible evidence does support a bounded statement that overall launch readiness passed on aggregate and general operational checks, but it does not support clean or completed compliance for the named deduction eligibility explanation context. The proper distinction is that caveated compliance would require evidence that the caveat was actually implemented in the final governance record; here, only the argument for doing so was supplied.
